response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded and open-source work, plus genuine low-latency distributed systems exposure at Sociomantic/dunnhumby and self-directed platform ownership at GISCollective. However, the role's core hard requirement — 8 years of C++ programming — is not met; the resume shows roughly six months of C/C++ work at National Instruments (2014–2015) and a university thesis, with C++ absent from the listed skills. Recent work is predominantly TypeScript/Node.js product engineering rather than large-scale cloud compute infrastructure, and there is no evidence of formal technical leadership of an internal compute platform or mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers. The gap between the resume and the minimum qualifications is too large to justify an interview for this specific requisition, though he could be a strong fit for platform/full-stack or developer-tooling roles.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience (15+ yrs) across backend, embedded, DevOps and open source
Real low-latency distributed systems work: microservices handling millions of req/sec at Sociomantic
Proven ownership and mentoring instincts — founded GISCollective, ran workshops, courses and dojos
concerns: C++ experience is ~6 months, far short of the required 8 years
No demonstrated cloud compute platform architecture or formal tech-lead role
Recent focus is TypeScript/Node product and AI tooling, not large-scale infrastructure

key_factors.factor: Lack of formal technical leadership of platform teams
